info.name: Blogging Platform IV - security
info.description:
Every security rule of Phase IV, with tests. Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner, in order.

Before running:
1. Start the app with an admin account: set ADMIN_PASSWORD (8+ characters) before the first start, e.g.
   $env:ADMIN_PASSWORD = "Admin-pass1"; ./mvnw spring-boot:run
2. Set the collection variables adminUsername / adminPassword to the same values (default username: admin).
3. baseUrl is http://localhost:8080.

Every run creates fresh users (reader_<run>, author_<run>), so the collection can run again and again.
The last folder deletes what the run created.
